scenes.title:
Your salary lands on the 1st.
By the 5th, it's everywhere.
scenes.voice: Your salary lands on the first. · By the fifth, it's scattered: UPI payments, a bank statement, subscriptions you forgot, money sent home. · Most apps record where it went. None of them tell you what it means for next month.

scenes.title:
A money model.
With a memory.
scenes.voice: This is Kosh: a living money model. · Statements, SMS and recurring payments come in messy. Kosh understands each line, finds the merchant, and recognises what repeats.

scenes.title: One fix becomes memory.
scenes.voice: Import a PDF, a CSV from any bank, or just paste your SMS. OTPs and spam are ignored. · Now watch this. EatClub was filed as 'Other'. I fix it once, · and Kosh writes a rule, corrects five past payments, and every future EatClub payment follows it. · One fix becomes memory.

scenes.title: Every rupee, followed.
scenes.voice: Here's October at a glance: ninety-five thousand in, seventy-two thousand three hundred out, twenty-four percent kept. · Kosh also noticed Netflix went up thirty percent, and asks if I still use Hotstar instead of guessing.

scenes.title: See the difference first.
scenes.voice: Before I decide, I ask. · Kosh turns plain words into numbers, and a deterministic engine projects the next year. My goal dates move in front of me. · Behind on a goal? Fix my plan finds the smallest realistic cuts that put everything back on time.

callouts.text: Fix my plan · every goal on time

scenes.title:
Money in India
is a family affair.
scenes.voice: Money in India is a family affair. · Kosh shows who's carrying the house, and the support that goes to Chhotu and Dadi. · Splitting a Goa trip? It settles the group in the fewest payments, without ever moving your money. · And Diwali is eight days away. Kosh saw it coming and built a pot for it.

scenes.title:
AI explains.
Code computes.
scenes.voice: Ask in English or Hinglish. Kosh answers from your own numbers. · It explains concepts, but it will never push a stock or promise returns. · AI reads and explains; plain code computes every rupee. · And at the end of the month, your story, wrapped.

scenes.title:
Import. Understand.
Simulate. Act.
scenes.voice: Import. Understand. Simulate. Act. · Kosh keeps your money model in step with your life. · Built entirely by voice, with Wispr Flow. · Open Kosh and see your own money in a new dimension.
